about_the_game:
Bearly Awesome is a fun blend of action, adventure, puzzle-solving and RPG. Players control cute and cuddly bear avatars, each with unique abilities, skills and customizations in an epic journey across diverse environments. Explore the enchanting fantasy world of Snuzzleland with your unique and adorable Bearlie, earn points and advance through fun levels! The top-down game blends exploration, puzzle-solving, light-hearted combat elements and cute characters in the ultimate furry adventure.

Bearly Awesome is a sweet and joyous experience – a mix of wholesome and mischievous fun – where heaps of cute characters and exciting events await. Quest through magical lands, overcome obstacles, battle quirky enemies who wreak havoc on the forest, solve puzzles, claim new territories and eat as many snacks as you can get your paws on.

Team up with friends or bond with new ones over your shared passion for mischief, fun and adventure. Some levels require you to be brave and resourceful, while others demand you to be quiet and sneaky as you manoeuvre around the campsite or the village without getting noticed.

Charming Graphics and Dynamic Gameplay

Enjoy varied, technical combat. Slide, jump, belly bump and strike! Face a wide cast of monsters, big and small — and explore colourful and connected worlds of lush forests, snowy mountains, busy towns, shady campsites and more. Discover hidden treasures and useful items to help you on your way.

Solve puzzles using your Bearlie’s special skills, such as moving objects with strength, digging for hidden items, or using agility to traverse tricky platforms. Collect Honeycomb Coins to unlock new abilities, items, and levels. Defeat enemies and overcome every challenge in this enchanting and unexpectedly dynamic world.

A Chill Game with Personality

Simple Controls make the game easy to enjoy and fun to play. Players earn Honeycomb Coins to level up their bear avatars, unlocking new areas and abilities. Or use their special Bearlie skills to bear through challenging obstacles or overcome exciting challenges. 

Play a single level to pass a few minutes of time or immerse yourself for hours in a beautifully cozy game world with fresh new challenges for players to complete!

Many Exciting Skins to Choose From

short_description: Transform into a furry Bearlie and explore a mysterious, daunting world full of endless surprises and quests. Use your bear skills wisely to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles and team up with other players to advance through the enchanted world.
